title: 🚚 Multiple Transportation Jobs in New York County - Up to $5K Weekly - NewsBreak
text:
18 hours ago New York County’s trucking and transport scene is rolling strong this month. Whether you’re an owner‑operator or a company driver, there are solid routes and paychecks waiting for you.
Class A CDL OTR Driver – Family‑Run Company Employer: Small family‑owned carrier
Location: 230 2nd Ave
Pay: Commission‑based with weekly bonuses
Type: Full‑time OTR
Enjoy steady miles, flexible home time, and a team that treats you like family. Ideal for drivers who value respect and reliability on the road.
CDL A Owner Operator – Intermodal Freight Employer: AWT Cartage Inc
Location: New York, NY (Ports of NJ area)
Pay: $3,000–$5,000 weekly average
Type: Owner‑Operator
Run local and regional intermodal loads with 73% linehaul pay plus 100% fuel surcharge. Flexible schedule and bonuses for Hazmat or Tanker endorsements.
CDL A W2 OTR Company Driver + Benefits Employer: J.S. Helwig & Son LLC
Location: New York, NY
Pay: $1,740–$2,080 weekly gross
Type: Company Driver (W2)
Earn up to $.65 CPM , enjoy full medical and dental, pet‑friendly trucks, and a generous referral bonus program. Modern equipment and steady miles included.
CDL‑A Owner Operator – Home Daily Employer: IMC Logistics, LLC
Location: Near Delancey Street, New York, NY
Pay: $3,500–$4,500 weekly + $1,000 sign‑on bonus
Type: Owner‑Operator
Close to the port for quick turnarounds, no‑touch freight, and top fuel discounts. Great fit for experienced port drivers with a TWIC card.
